title: narumi minutes ensemble opaque processing identifiers
$comment: Opaque identity primitives shared by the finalized ensemble run, provenance and artifact response shapes.

processing_run_id.description: Opaque minutes ensemble run identifier. Never a job ID, arbitrary path or proof of a new external call.

processing_slot_id.description: Opaque canonical generator slot. It represents semantic selection/duplicate identity and is not derived from a UI generator ID, label or array position.

processing_node_id.description: Opaque node identifier within the currently inspected ensemble run. Content fingerprints and attempt origins are separate fields.

processing_call_id.description: Opaque external-call identifier for the currently inspected node. Not a provider response ID or a promise that the service processed only one request.

processing_attempt_id.description: Opaque attempt identifier. Its saved record supplies the original execution provenance; callers must not substitute the current run as that origin.

processing_artifact_id.description: Opaque immutable artifact identifier. Read access also requires the owning meeting scope and membership or recorded reuse in the requested run.

processing_runs_cursor.description: Opaque URL-safe page cursor bound to the requested meeting, scope and stable created_at-descending/run_id order. Do not decode it into user-controlled paths. Invalid or mismatched cursors are rejected; scope is rechecked on every page.

processing_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA256 for validated content/configuration. This content fingerprint is distinct from opaque run/node/call/attempt/artifact identity and must not contain secret material.
